purpose: The service manages customer wallet balances and executes transactions such as top-ups, transfers, and profile updates.

components.name: Keycloak
components.evidence: identity provider (the 2021 text used a home-grown login service; it was retired in 2023).

flows.evidence: The mobile application reaches it through the Mobile API Gateway (called "mobile edge" in the proposal).
The 2021 text described a monolithic application with a shared database; the current design separates the service and its own database, wallet-db.
Every request to an externally reachable endpoint is authenticated, either with an OIDC bearer token or with a mutual TLS client certificate.
